summary: Recognize current macOS launchd disabled states during host migration and installer rollback

rules.detail: Migration still requires staged targets to be disabled and stopped; unknown launchd states now produce an error.

compatibility.detail: Accept both true/false and disabled/enabled launchctl print-disabled formats. Installer backups retain effective enablement in either format.

downtime.detail: No additional downtime; the existing explicit host cutover procedure is unchanged.

manual.detail: No new manual step. Previously refused host migrations can be retried using the updated CLI.

recovery.detail: Existing migration recovery and installer rollback remain available. Revert the change to restore the previous parsers.
